title: Every Opus bug-fix run, step by step
label: Historical · Compound 0.14.0
description: Claude Opus 5.5, the 30 runs on the three bug reports without Compound and with 0.14.0, in recorded order, each row lined up on its first source edit; steps in order, not to time scale. Steps come from a logging wrapper around python in both arms and a file watcher; nothing in the prompt asked for tests. A failing-test mark right of the line was shown by undoing the fix briefly. Running the unfixed code counts as reproducing the bug only when its output showed the bug. A pytest call is drawn as another run: pytest is not installed for this library, so it ran no test.
